user_decision: Use both historical Strategy Tester and MetaQuotes-Demo; historical first, live last for reconfirmation.
historical_evidence_label: ENGINEERING HISTORICAL EVIDENCE / NOT FINAL TICK-ACCURATE
final_status_rule: FINAL PASS requires every mandatory historical_required case to PASS (subject to matrix conditional exceptions), then every mandatory live_only and live_reconfirm case to PASS on attributable MetaQuotes-Demo evidence. A contradiction in either phase blocks final PASS.
rules: Historical evidence never proves broker-specific facts that the tester cannot observe.
Historical phase may advance across R3-R6 without mutating the live Q10 state machine.
live_reconfirm_cases are intentionally a subset of historical_required_cases and are repeated live after Phase H as representative stage confirmation.
live_only_cases are broker/runtime dependent and cannot be closed by Strategy Tester evidence.
The final live phase begins only after Phase H reaches its allowed completion state.
A tester PASS cannot overwrite a contradictory live FAIL.

R3-03 remains historical-required but may PASS by deterministic-by-construction verification of the canonical immediate EMA50(Close) mapping plus fail-closed transition behavior; natural non-equality transition occurrence is not required.
Any contradiction between historical and live evidence is FAIL/VERIFICATION REQUIRED, never silently reconciled.
No historical optimization or rule tuning is authorized by this policy.
Exact Build 5.11 source/EX4/settings identity remains mandatory.
R5-14 broker-comment stripping/replacement and R5-16 broker retryable-error occurrence are LIVE_ONLY because Strategy Tester/static evidence cannot prove server-side broker behavior.
